name: beyond-erp
description: Beyond ERP - Enterprise Resource Planning System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
